rows.text: wins a **Rs 30,36,79,635 work order from NHAI**, on competitive bidding, to act as user-fee agency for one year at the Manambadi plaza on the Sethiyathope-Cholapuram section of NH-36 in Tamil Nadu

receives a GST show-cause notice proposing recovery of **Rs 10.70 crore** for FY2020-21 to FY2024-25 on exemptions claimed for user-fee toll collection; it notes an appellate order of 11 August decided a substantially similar matter in its favour.
bags an NHAI toll collection and maintenance contract for the Etaura Bujurg and Akhtiyari Kotila plazas in Uttar Pradesh for 1 year, at a gross value of Rs 51.54 cr.

the press release the company filed today puts a number on the NHAI mandate that **ran unquantified in `highlights_2026-08-10_polished.md`**: the Letter of Award for the **Aashpur Fee Plaza at Design Km 231.100 on the Aligarh–Kanpur section of NH-91, Uttar Pradesh**, granted **10-Aug** after a competitive e-tender, runs **one year** with a **broad commercial consideration of Rs 83,29,29,635**, and the scope extends beyond toll collection to the upkeep of adjacent toilet blocks. **The company's own caveat is the reason this is not a mover, and it is unusually candid:** the figure *"reflects the gross value of the engagement under the toll collection framework, where collections are remitted to NHAI and the Company retains an agreed spread"* and *"should not be interpreted as an expected direct or proportionate addition to net revenue"*. So the ~12.4% of a Rs 672.01 cr market cap measures money passing through, not money earned. **[Hazoor Multi Projects](https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachLive/a67867e9-5f3b-4ad2-8786-dbf0debe22df.pdf)** filed the same class of item — an **NHAI Letter of Award dated 10-Aug for user-fee collection at the Ramnagar fee plaza at Km 1280.370 on the Baran–Shivpuri section of New NH-27 in Madhya Pradesh, at Rs 24.33 crore** (~4.0% of a Rs 611.78 cr market cap) — and the same gross-collection caveat applies to it.
